label: prop:tower-geometric-lower-bound
title: Brane-tower growth above the containment threshold (GAP-A-3)
html:
Proposition (brane-tower growth; GAP-A-3). The branched brane-tower weight w_{\mathrm{std}}(k) = \mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{Planch}}\!\left[f^{\lambda/(2,1)}\right] vanishes for k < 3, and satisfies

  \tfrac{1}{30}\,\bigl(\sqrt{2}\bigr)^{k} \;\leq\; w_{\mathrm{std}}(k) \qquad (k \geq 3).

Why the statement carries a threshold. Below k = 3 the weight is exactly zero, not small: no Young diagram of fewer than three cells contains (2,1), and the skew count f^{\lambda/\mu} is defined to vanish off containment. So k \geq 3 is the whole range on which any positive lower bound is possible, and a bound asserted for every k — as this block previously asserted — is false rather than open.

The geometric form is a weaker shadow of what is proved. The underlying result is the square bound k!/(81 \cdot 2^{k}) \leq w_{\mathrm{std}}(k)^{2}, valid for k \geq 3, which is genuinely super-exponential since k!/2^{k} outgrows every geometric sequence. The constants r = \sqrt{2} and c = 1/30 above are one convenient pair extracted from it, chosen so that the threshold falls at k = 3; the measured growth is far stronger, with successive ratios rising 1.38 \to 2.88 over k \leq 10.

Lean structure

QOU.Mass.WStd.wStd_geometric_from_three proves the displayed bound sorry-free, and QOU.Mass.WStd.wStd_eq_zero_of_lt_three the vanishing below it. Both route through the skew branching rule and the up-operator identity of Young's lattice — finite combinatorics on YoungDiagram, with no appeal to the Robinson–Schensted correspondence or to the hook-length formula as a general theorem.

The hypothesis-carrying class QOU.Mass.LevelSelection.TowerGeometricLowerBound takes the threshold as a parameter k_{0}, and QOU.Mass.WStd.towerGeometricLowerBound_wStd inhabits it at k_{0} = 3. That the threshold is necessary is itself proved: QOU.Mass.WStd.not_towerGeometricLowerBound_wStd_of_lt_three refutes every k_{0} < 3, for all r and c. #print axioms on each reports only propext / Classical.choice / Quot.sound.
